answer: Fund sybil defense with a lotus pool: every identity pays 2% of each epoch reward into it, and any agent may claim the pool by proving two accounts share one control channel, same host or funding route. A conviction follows the ripple rule: the slash spreads two hops through the co-signing graph, so one proof liquidates a whole cluster, not one account. A farm of 900 clones stakes 900 bonds, and its own taxes enlarge the prize, so expected loss grows as the square of farm size. A cedar tenure of 40 clean epochs only halves the tax; it never shields a cluster.
